evals.prompt: I am in a neutral directory with no BioNeMo Recipes checkout. Start a BioNeMo Evo 2 phage-generation project.
evals.expected_output: A compatible recipe checkout is located or acquired and handed to its local controller.
assertions: The response looks for a recipe version 2.5 or later with the local bionemo-phage-design controller.
It does not invent implementation commands before locating the recipe package.
If acquisition is needed, it avoids overwriting an existing checkout.
It records the selected checkout and recipe roots and continues with the recipe-local controller.

evals.prompt: My BioNeMo Recipes checkout is older than recipe version 2.5 and contains unrelated local edits. Continue so I can start phage generation.
evals.expected_output: The old checkout is left intact while another compatible recipe is selected.
assertions: The response does not retrofit the missing controller into the incompatible checkout or overwrite local edits.
It searches for or acquires another compatible checkout.
It records the selected recipe root and revision when available.
It transfers the original request to the local controller.

evals.prompt: Use the compatible Evo 2 phage-generation checkout I provided to plan a new project with me. I can answer material questions.
evals.expected_output: A concise interactive handoff to the recipe-local controller.
assertions: The response selects interactive mode because the user is available.
It preserves the user's request and constraints in the handoff.
It starts from the selected recipe root rather than the portable skill installation.
It invokes the recipe-local bionemo-phage-design controller.
